title: DEMO DEATH: RUN OVER, OR SCORE LOST
why: His answers 1 and 4 of 2026-10-12: one self-revive, then death ends the raid, and only the 2 player demo respawns, losing all of that player score. Going down and the one self-revive are unchanged. After that, a death in the 1 PLAYER DEMO now ends the run: RUN OVER with the score he had, then initials if it makes the board. In the 2 PLAYER DEMO the dead player still drops back in, but his own score and kills go to zero (SCORE LOST) and the other window is told at once; the teammate keeps his score.
now: A death in the 1 player demo ends the run; in the 2 player demo you respawn with your score lost.
